annotations.title: One glance: is this MCP server verified, with proof

description: A single machine-first answer for an agent deciding whether to trust an MCP endpoint BEFORE it connects. Returns verified (true only when the latest scheduled measurement passed every measured condition; null otherwise, never false), a state enum saying which case it is, measured_at, and a record_sha256 with a recompute_url so you can check the verdict without trusting this gate. Reads the stored register only: it contacts nothing and measures nothing. Absent and pending are reported honestly and are NOT negative verdicts. For a fresh measurement rather than the stored one, use check_conformance.

endpoint.description: https URL of the MCP endpoint to look up, exactly as it appears on the register

name: is_verified

outputSchema.description: A one-glance answer for an agent deciding whether to trust an MCP endpoint BEFORE connecting. Reads the register only; measures nothing. verified is true ONLY when the latest scheduled measurement passed every measured condition; it is null in every other case (pending, held, watched, absent), and never false, because this gate calls nothing a failure. The state enum says which case it is, so a consumer can tell 'not verified here' apart from 'the lookup failed' (that returns as a tool error, isError) and from 'measured and passing'.

absence_vs_failure.description: Measured endpoints only: condition 06 from the latest measurement, disclosed and never a verdict.

conditions.description: Per condition: true passed, false did not pass, null not measured. null as a whole when nothing was measured.

endpoint.description: The endpoint you asked about, echoed.

gate_commit.description: Git commit of the deployed gate, or a sentence saying the deployment did not pin one.

history_url.description: URL of the stored measurements for this endpoint.

how_to_appear.description: Absent endpoint only: how anyone can add it to the register.

measured_at.description: Time of the latest stored measurement, or null when there is none.

measurements.description: Measured endpoints only: how many measurements are stored.

not_an_endorsement.description: What a verified reading does not claim.

on_register.description: true = the endpoint has a row here. false = the register was read and it has none.

reason.description: One sentence saying why state has the value it has.

recompute_note.description: How to recompute record_sha256 from record_url, or why it cannot be recomputed.

recompute_url.description: Where to fetch what record_sha256 can be checked against: record_url when it exists, otherwise the history.

record_sha256.description: Hash of the latest verdict. Recompute it via recompute_url; no trust in this gate required.

record_url.description: URL of the exact bytes that record_sha256 hashes, or null for a verdict stored before those bytes were kept.

state.description: verified = passed all measured conditions. pending = measured but not passing every one (often only because determinism needs the owner's consent). held = could not be reached. watched = on the list, not yet measured. absent = no row here at all.

verified.description: true = latest measurement passed all measured conditions. null = not established here (see state). Never false: unmeasured or not-yet-passing is not a failure.

verified_meaning.description: What verified true and null mean.
